subject: HealthScope discovery — model fit & safety follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@healthscope.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthscope.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthScope discovery — model fit & safety follow-up

Hi Amy / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and agreed next steps: 

1) What we heard
- Primary use case: patient triage assistant (clinical intake + routing) with strict refusal behavior on clinical advice and PHI handling.
- Success metrics: <=200ms median token latency at 99th percentile for 4k sequences, precision on triage labels >=92% on your benchmark set, and no unsafe clinical suggestions per your policy suite.

2) Proposed model family / configuration (initial suggestions)
- Candidate 1 (cost-balanced): redwood-medium-8k-quant (good latency/cost tradeoff, strong general NLU)
- Candidate 2 (safety-focused): redwood-safety-tuned-13b (softer refusal defaults, trained on refusal prompts)
- Fallbacks: open-llama-30b (for edge cases)

3) Shared artifacts (attached / links)
- healthscope_prompt_set_v1.csv (examples used in call)
- healthscope_benchmark_report.pdf (example benchmark for similar healthcare workloads)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHealthScopeBenchmarks

4) Safety & compliance notes
- We will run a focused safety/refusal eval suite (sensitive-domain prompts, adversarial rewrites, instruction-following tests) and provide a report with failure modes and mitigations.
- For PHI handling, Redwood supports customer-managed KMS and VPC/private deployment options if you need on-prem or private-inference.

5) Next steps (agreed)
- You: share a de-identified sample of 500 triage prompts + expected labels (target by EOD Wed)
- Us: run initial model fit & safety evals and share a prioritized issues list (ETA Fri)
- Schedule: 60-min technical deep-dive with Neha (SE) to review eval results and deployment options — propose Tue 23 or Thu 25 next week

Let me know if I missed anything.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference — inference that scales.

Attachments: healthscope_prompt_set_v1.csv, healthscope_benchmark_report.pdf

From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@healthscope.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthscope.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HealthScope discovery — model fit & safety follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this matches our notes. A couple of follow-ups from Security/Legal that I wanted to flag now so we can include them in the evals:

- Can you confirm refusal behavior for medical advice prompts? We need to see deterministic refusal on a standard set of escalation prompts and the ability to customize/refine promoters that trigger a hard refusal.
- We also need an initial SOC 2 + data retention writeup and an example DPA template (Tom will own procurement).
- For the de-identified sample, is 500 prompts sufficient to get useful model fit signals? We may have to scrub more to capture rare edge cases (intentional adversarial phrasings).

Attachment: healthscope_security_questionnaire.pdf (internal) — I've attached our baseline so you can pre-check.

Amy
Director, Digital Care Innovation | HealthScope
amy.chen@healthscope.com | 617-555-0199

Subject: Fwd: HealthScope discovery — model fit & safety follow-up

Neha —

Forwarding Amy's note and the security questionnaire. They want: deterministic/controlled refusal behavior, SOC 2/DPA examples, and guidance on sample size for model-fit. Can you:

- Confirm our safety-eval plan and attach a sketched evaluation matrix (adversarial prompts, refusal rate targets, PHI leakage tests)
- Recommend which of our model variants to prioritize for the initial run (given their latency SLO and safety needs)
- Propose dates for a 60-min deep dive next week (I suggested Tue/Thu)

High level: this is a top-priority expansion lead. Deal id HS-2026-045.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachment forwarded: healthscope_security_questionnaire.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@healthscope.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HealthScope discovery — model fit & safety follow-up

Hi Amy / Marissa —

Thanks for the notes, Amy — see responses and an attached evaluation plan: redwood_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx (includes test matrix and acceptance thresholds) and an updated prompt set (healthscope_prompt_set_v2.csv). Link to the sandbox benchmark outputs will be populated here after run: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHealthScopeBenchmarks

Highlights / answers: 
- Refusal behavior: our safety-tuned variants (redwood-safety-tuned-13b) include a refusal classifier and policy-layer that enforces hard-refuse for clinical-advice patterns by default. We can provide a custom blocklist and tune the classifier with your adversarial examples. Targets: >99% hard-refuse rate on canonical clinical-advice prompts in our internal test suite, with documented false-positive rate <=2%.
- PHI handling: for initial eval, de-identified prompts are fine. For full production we recommend Redwood Private (VPC + customer KMS) if you need strict custody.
- Sample size: 500 is a good starting point to catch common failure modes; for rare adversarial attacks we recommend an augmented set (2k-5k) including paraphrases and adversarial rewrites. We can help synthesize adversarial variants if you prefer.
- SOC 2/DPA: attaching a short SOC 2 summary and a DPA template link — I'll have legal follow up for formal DPA.

Proposed next steps / schedule:
- We will ingest your de-identified 500 prompts and run the initial model-fit + safety evals (ETA: 48 hours after receipt).
- Post-run deep dive with SE & PM: Tue 30 Jun 2026 10:00 AM PT or Thu 02 Jul 2026 11:00 AM PT — please confirm which works.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx, healthscope_prompt_set_v2.csv
